https://newsonjapan.com/article/151213.p.title: AI Film Festival Japan Draws 730 Entries From More Than 60 Countries | News On Japan
https://newsonjapan.com/article/151213.p.p1:
TOKYO -
 The AI Film Festival Japan 2026, one of Asia's largest international film festivals dedicated to works created using artificial intelligence, held its awards ceremony in Tokyo on November 1, attracting more than 730 submissions from over 60 countries and regions, with short films and animation accounting for the majority of entries.
https://newsonjapan.com/article/151213.p.p2: The festival, now in its second year, was first held in Tokyo in November 2025 and has expanded rapidly as advances in generative AI make sophisticated video production increasingly accessible to independent filmmakers and creators. As AI technology becomes more deeply integrated into everyday life, film festivals specializing in AI-generated content have emerged around the world, providing opportunities for artists to explore new forms of storytelling and visual expression. This year's festival, held from October 31 to November 2 at Tokyo Innovation Base in the Marunouchi district, attracted a diverse range of submissions, including narrative films, animation, experimental productions and works incorporating AI-generated music. From the more than 730 entries, organizers selected 68 works for official screening, with 21 advancing to the final round of judging. Japan, China and South Korea accounted for more than half of all submissions, highlighting East Asia's growing prominence in AI-assisted filmmaking. Most entries were short films or animated productions lasting approximately five to 10 minutes, reflecting the increasing popularity of compact storytelling formats among creators experimenting with generative video technology. Among the AI tools used by participants, Seedance, a video generation system developed by China's ByteDance, the company behind TikTok, was the most widely used. Suno, an AI music generation platform developed by the American company of the same name, ranked second, demonstrating the growing importance of AI-generated soundtracks and music in filmmaking. The increasing sophistication of these technologies has enabled individual creators and small production teams to produce films that previously required substantial budgets, specialized equipment and large crews. AI tools can now generate moving images, characters, backgrounds and musical compositions, allowing filmmakers to concentrate more heavily on storytelling, direction and creative concepts. Recognizing the expanding role of music in AI filmmaking, organizers introduced a new AI Film Music and Score category this year. The competition evaluated how effectively creators could use artificial intelligence to compose music that complemented visual sequences, emphasizing synchronization, musical quality and emotional impact. Ayano Kotakagari, a young creator at Nippon Television's production company NTV AX-ON, won the top award in the newly established category. The festival's founder and executive committee chairman, Kazunori Kurimoto, emphasized that technological advances alone would not determine the artistic quality of AI-generated films. Kurimoto said that although AI technology continues to evolve rapidly, the ultimate quality of a production depends on the creator's individual worldview, imagination and originality. His remarks reflected a central theme of the festival: while artificial intelligence is transforming how films are produced, the ability to develop compelling stories and distinctive artistic visions remains fundamentally dependent on human creativity.

https://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp.title: Pierre Leclercq Succeeds Mark Adams as Head of Design of Opel and Vauxhall  |  WebWire
https://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp.p1: Pierre Leclercq has been appointed Head of Design for Opel and Vauxhall with immediate effect. Leclercq succeeds Mark Adams, who is retiring after almost 25 years with the company. Leclercq will continue to report to Florian Huettl, CEO of Opel and Vauxhall, and Gilles Vidal, Stellantis Head of Design for European Brands. The Belgian national will also join the Opel Executive Committee. Until now, the 54-year-old has served as Head of Design for Citroën. In this role, he helped strengthen the brands identity and supported the renewal of its product range. I would like to thank Mark Adams for his commitment, inspiration and service for almost a quarter of a century. Mark served as Vice President Design longer than any of his predecessors. His work and vision have shaped what Opel and Vauxhall are today. We wish him the very best for his well-deserved retirement. At the same time, we are delighted to welcome Pierre Leclercq as Head of Design. His global background and vision are tremendous assets in supporting the evolution of Opel and Vauxhall, said Florian Huettl. Pierre has a deep understanding of brand identity and a recognised ability to translate strategic vision into desirable products. His international experience, creativity, and high standards will be invaluable assets in continuing the development of Opel Design and reinforcing its unique positioning within the European market. I would also like to warmly thank Mark Adams for his contribution to the development of Opel Design. His work has helped shape the modern face of Opel and Vauxhall and strengthen their personality over the past years. We wish him all the best for this new chapter in his life, said Gilles Vidal. Pierre Leclercq graduated from ArtCenter College of Design in Pasadena, California, in 1998. He began his career at Fords Ghia design studio in Italy before joining BMW Group in 2000. Over the following decade, he worked across BMW, MINI and Rolls-Royce, before being appointed Head of Design for BMW M, the brands high-performance division, in 2011. He subsequently pursued an international career, becoming Head of Design at Great Wall Motors in China in 2013, before joining Kia Motors in South Korea as Design Director in 2017. On November 1, 2018, he became Head of Citroën Design. Since then, Pierre Leclercq has helped shape a renewed design identity for the Citroën line-up. He has led the design of a broad range of models and concepts, including the 2 CV and 2 CV Fourgonnette concepts unveiled at the Paris Motor Show, ELO and OLI, the new C3, C3 Aircross and Basalt, the new Ami, C4 and C4 X, and the new C5 Aircross. Mark Adams has had a long and stellar career in the automotive industry for over 40 years. After already holding various Chief designer and Executive positions at Ford in Europe and the US, he joined Opel and Vauxhall in 2002 as Director of Exterior Design to spearhead the development of a new exterior design philosophy. He was promoted to Vice President Design in 2007 and has led all production and concept vehicles since then. These include many production vehicles such as the Corsa , ADAM, Mokka , Astra and Insignia, as well as some inspirational and iconic concepts like the 2003 Insignia Concept, 2013 Monza Concept, 2016 GT Concept and the 2018 GTX Experimental , a car that heavily inspired the current generation Opel Mokka. Adams has also been the driving force behind Opels Bold and Pure design language, which was started back in 2017 and introduced the Opel Vizor brand face, the Opel Compass and the interior Pure Panel, which have now been rolled out to every vehicle within the Opel and Vauxhall portfolio. He has more recently been crafting the brands next ambitious step forward for its exterior and interior design language. The creative exterior direction is visible on Opels most recent concept car, the STX Concept , which celebrated its world premiere at the Paris Motor Show and shows the next confident step of Bold and Pure, which will influence future Opel models.

https://www.chronicle.lu/category/intern.title: Binance Says Outflows Normalised as North Korea Rejects US Allegation Over Heist
https://www.chronicle.lu/category/intern.p1: Published on Tuesday, 03 Nov 2026 09:34 by SM
https://www.chronicle.lu/category/intern.p2: SEOUL/SINGAPORE (Reuters) - Asset outflows from Binance have normalised and the company was in "very strong financial health" , its co-CEO said on Tuesday 3 November 2026, as North Korea dismissed as "absurd rhetoric" US allegations that it was behind a $6.3 billion cryptocurrency heist on its platform. The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, whose customers had withdrawn a net $4.72 billion (€4.22 billion) as of Monday 2 November after it was hit with what could be the largest-ever financial heist last week, has also launched a campaign to stem outflows and woo new users. "In the first 24 hours, there was a spike in terms of withdrawals, as can be expected. But after that ... it's pretty much normalised," Richard Teng told a Hong Kong Fintech Week event on Tuesday. "The company is in very strong financial health," he said, adding 95% of the affected tokens had been replenished. "This is something that we can cover. We are able to do so." The crypto exchange was seeing "hourly deposits exceed withdrawals" , Binance said in an X post earlier on Tuesday, adding that it reflected improving user activity and stabilising flows. The FBI said at the weekend that North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion (€5.36 billion) in crypto assets, a crime that sent shockwaves through the industry. Kim Yo Jong, the influential sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, said the US allegations proved Washington remained hostile towards Pyongyang, according to a report on Tuesday by state news agency KCNA. Pyongyang has not responded to US President Donald Trump's overtures, made earlier this year, to resume summit diplomacy. In the wake of the US allegations, Kim Yo Jong said North Korea had " issues to reconsider" over what she called US hostility. "The FBI is trying to brand the DPRK as a 'cybercriminal state,' claiming that it obtained information that a hacking organization 'supported' by the DPRK was involved in the incident," KCNA quoted Kim Yo Jong as saying. "But the US assertion is absurd rhetoric and nothing new," said Kim, a ruling party official. DPRK is short for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. "It is a grave political provocation against the DPRK that the US misleads international public opinion as if all the cybercrimes in different parts of the world are our deeds." Revenue stream North Korea faces growing scrutiny over cryptocurrency theft, which analysts say is a key source of funds for its weapons programmes. Cybersecurity experts say North Korean hackers are among the world's most prolific crypto thieves and the proceeds help fund the country's efforts to develop nuclear weapons and ballistic missiles capable of hitting the United States. North Korea has stolen cryptocurrency worth $7.6 billion (€6.79 billion) this year, more than in any previous year, according to estimates by blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. North Korea denies allegations linking it to cryptocurrency theft and other cybercrimes. Analysts in Seoul said Pyongyang's unusually swift response likely reflected concern that the allegation could lead to tighter efforts to disrupt revenue streams that North Korea is accused of using to finance its weapons. "With sanctions already in place, cryptocurrency theft has become one of North Korea's key channels for securing funds for regime maintenance and weapons development," said Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies. Additional US measures targeting crypto wallets, laundering networks and cryptocurrency exchanges could choke off an important source of revenue, Lim said. South Korea's central bank estimated North Korea's gross domestic product at 47.18 trillion won (€31.33 billion) in 2025, meaning the Binance theft could be equivalent to about a sixth of its economic output. Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis estimated 89% of crypto hack losses in 2026 were linked to North Korea, up from 15% in 2021. It said the average reported loss per hack rose from $50.65 million (€45.26 million) in 2021 to $185.65 million (€165.84 million) in 2026. "I guess you could call it big game hunting, where they're targeting these larger exchanges that may take more time and more complexity to be able to do ... but the payoff can be relatively large," said Alec Zebrick, senior manager of Asia-Pacific Global Services at Chainalysis. North Korea is one of the world's most impoverished countries but has poured resources secured through illicit means and activities banned under UN Security Council resolutions into its missile and nuclear programmes. Kim Yo Jong said North Korea would "reconsider" unspecified issues in light of the " very unpleasant US hostile attitude" , without elaborating. North Korea has not publicly responded to Trump's offers to resume summit diplomacy. Binance withdrawals Binance launched a campaign on Monday offering fee rebates, rewards to eligible users who rack up at least $10,000 (€8,929.57) in cumulative trading volume, as well as annual percentage rates of up to 10% on certain yield-generating products. The exchange's "community appreciation campaign" will run through Saturday 21 November, a post on its website showed. Binance, which froze withdrawals for more than two days after the hack and then started allowing customers to withdraw again on Sunday morning in some assets, reopened withdrawals for more assets on Tuesday. Since the resumption of withdrawals, Binance has seen net outflows amounting to around 3% of the assets on its platform, it said on Monday, a relatively modest figure that analysts said suggested customer confidence had largely held up. "The relatively contained price reaction suggests a degree of maturity and resilience," said Maksym Repa, head of DeFi at Lombard, a Bitcoin finance protocol backed by Franklin Templeton. "Investors appear to be distinguishing between a security failure at a centralised exchange and a problem with the Bitcoin network itself."

https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p2: The US midterm elections on Tuesday mark a major turning point for Seoul’s relations with Washington and its foreign policy more broadly. The outcome will have a profound impact on the domestic and foreign policies of US President Donald Trump, who has plunged both his own country and the international community into turmoil. Even if the Democrats win, Trump could refuse to accept the results or simply ignore them and double down on his policies. His threat to resume attacks on Iran after the midterms is a case in point. Nevertheless, an election defeat would undermine Trump’s authority and his ability to carry out his agenda. Trump’s signature initiatives — including his war against Iran, his efforts to end the war in Ukraine, and his trade and tariff campaign against countries around the world — have ground to a halt over the past few months. Facing resistance from the countries affected, Trump has put off further negotiations until after the midterms. Despite Trump’s threats to resume attacks, Iran has steadfastly refused to negotiate unless the seven conditions in its seven-day confidence-building plan are met. Those conditions include the US lifting its naval blockade and releasing frozen assets. Separately, Russia has agreed to participate in US-mediated three-party talks with Ukraine but postponed them until after the midterms. Moscow has secured partial relief from US sanctions, including restrictions on diesel exports, while refusing to budge on its current conditions for ending the fighting. Canada, which has been one of the fiercest opponents of Trump’s trade onslaught, also persuaded him to withdraw the 50% tariffs he had imposed before postponing a new trade agreement until the midterms are over. While discussing the two countries’ trade talks on Oct. 26, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said that “to the extent any progress has been made, it’s because the US is coming closer to our position.”

https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.title: Difficulty fitting in at school cited by 36% of migrant-background dropouts in Korea
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p1: The high school dropout has never forgotten what his teachers said right in front of him on his first day at a Korean school.
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p2: “Why should we have to teach this kid? He’s Chinese.” The student had acquired Korean citizenship when his Chinese mother remarried a Korean man and brought him to Korea. He spoke little Korean, but that did not prevent him from sensing awkwardness in the air. When he opened a translation app, he saw remarks such as, “Why should we have to educate him with our tax money?” That tough initiation into Korean school life was followed by one hardship after another. The biggest problem was understanding lessons taught in Korean, especially since the school did not provide any assistance in translating his learning materials. Eventually, he dropped out. With the number of students from migrant backgrounds in Korea surpassing 210,000 this year, the dropout rate among high school students in the group reached 2.15% in the 2024 academic year, exceeding 2% for the second consecutive year. Students from migrant backgrounds constitute a diverse group that includes those who are from another country, as well as those whose parents (one or both) are from another country or have foreign nationality. According to data obtained on Monday from the Ministry of Education by Rep. Kang Kyung-sook, a lawmaker with the Rebuilding Korea Party, 594 of 27,673 high school students from migrant backgrounds dropped out during the 2024 academic year. The figures show that the dropout rate has been rising steadily since 2020, when it stood at 1.36%. The dropout rate among students from migrant backgrounds was not significantly different from the 2.1% rate for high school students overall in 2024. But their reasons for leaving school were markedly different. Among students from migrant backgrounds who dropped out, 35.7% cited difficulty adjusting to school, compared with 14.5% among the high school dropouts overall — a rate roughly 2.5 times as high. That disparity appears to reflect the pressures facing students like the one introduced above, including a lack of educational support such as translation and interpretation services, as well as the insensitivity of teachers and classmates. In Korea’s fiercely competitive education system, these students often struggle to find the help they need to find their footing. Looking across elementary, middle and high schools, the number of students from migrant backgrounds who dropped out or otherwise discontinued their education rose from 987 (0.67%) in the 2020 academic year to 2,226 (1.15%) in 2024. That latter figure is slightly higher than the 1.06% rate among elementary, middle and high school students overall. But staying in school is no guarantee that everything is going just fine. When an anti-Chinese demonstration in Seoul’s Daerim neighborhood came up in a multicultural lesson at one middle school, some students said that “Chinese people should leave Korea.” A student from China who was in the classroom laughed off the remarks. Another high school student, whose parents are ethnic Koreans from China, was insulted with pejorative language during an argument with a classmate: “Get out of here, you [expletive].” Although the classmate later apologized, the student struggled to recover emotionally and ended up staying away from school for a year. “There are power dynamics even within the classroom that make it difficult for students from migrant backgrounds to call out discriminatory remarks by other students,” said a middle school teacher. “They may be afraid that speaking up would make them targets of hatred themselves.” There are also concerns that President Lee Jae Myung’s recent remarks about “reverse discrimination” — he claims that migrants and multicultural families receive preferential treatment in certain government programs — could further fuel the discrimination and hostility faced by students from migrant backgrounds. “Remarks that judge migrants by their economic contributions or need for support, rather than recognizing them as members of Korean society, could foster the perception that it’s also acceptable to exclude students from migrant backgrounds in the classroom,” said Lee Seung-mi, director of the Ansan Global Youth Center in Gyeonggi Province. “Given that young people from migrant backgrounds often come to feel ashamed of their identities as they grow up, I’m worried that President Lee’s remarks could have a negative impact,” she added. Lee also criticized the president’s use of the term “reverse discrimination.” “The attitude implicit behind that term is viewing migrant workers as a source of labor while disregarding their living conditions and human rights,” she said.

https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/.title: North Korea says US allegations linking it to Binance heist are âabsurd rhetoricâ
https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/.p1: SEOUL, Nov 3 (Reuters) - North Korea on Tuesday dismissed as "absurd rhetoric" US allegations that it was behind a $6 billion cryptocurrency heist on the Binance platform, saying they proved Washington remained hostile towards it, state news agency KCNA said.
https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/.p2: By Jack Kim and Kyu-seok Shim The denial by Kim Yo Jong, the influential sister of leader Kim Jong Un, comes as Pyongyang has stayed silent on US President Donald Trump's overtures to resume summit diplomacy. In the wake of the US allegations, she said North Korea had "issues to reconsider" over what she called US hostility. The FBI said at the weekend that North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion in virtual assets from Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, in what could be the largest-ever financial heist. "The FBI is trying to brand the DPRK as a 'cyber criminal state,' claiming that it obtained information that a hacking organization 'supported' by the DPRK was involved in the incident," KCNA quoted Kim Yo Jong, a ruling party official, as saying. DPRK is short for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. "But the US assertion is absurd rhetoric and nothing new," Kim said. "It is a grave political provocation against the DPRK that the US misleads international public opinion as if all the cyber crimes in different parts of the world are our deeds." REVENUE STREAM Cybersecurity experts say North Korean hackers are among the world's most prolific crypto thieves and the proceeds help fund the country's weapons programmes. North Korea denies allegations linking it to cryptocurrency theft and other cybercrimes. Analysts in Seoul said Pyongyang's unusually swift response likely reflected concern that the allegation could lead to tighter efforts to disrupt revenue streams that North Korea is accused of using to finance its weapons. "With sanctions already in place, cryptocurrency theft has become one of North Korea's key channels for securing funds for regime maintenance and weapons development," said Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies. Additional US measures targeting crypto wallets, laundering networks and cryptocurrency exchanges could choke off an important source of revenue, Lim said. South Korea's central bank estimated North Korea's gross domestic product at 47.18 trillion won ($35.09 billion) in 2025, meaning the Binance theft could be equivalent to about a sixth of its economic output. Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis estimated 89% of crypto hack losses in 2026 were linked to North Korea, up from 15% in 2021. It said the average reported loss per hack rose from $50.65 million in 2021 to $185.65 million in 2026. "I guess you could call it big game hunting, where they're targeting these larger exchanges that may take more time and more complexity to be able to do ... but the payoff can be relatively large," said Alec Zebrick, senior manager of Asia-Pacific Global Services at Chainalysis. KEY MESSAGE North Korea is one of the world's most impoverished countries but has poured resources secured through illicit means and activities banned under UN Security Council resolutions into its ballistic missile and nuclear weapons programmes. Kim Yo Jong said North Korea would "reconsider" unspecified issues in light of the "very unpleasant US hostile attitude", without elaborating. North Korea has not publicly responded to Trump's offers to resume summit diplomacy. "The key message is not about cyber theft itself, but about US-North Korea relations," said Hong Min, a senior researcher at the Korea Institute for National Unification in Seoul. "Pyongyang is essentially saying: don't use this issue as leverage or pressure if you want to keep the door to dialogue open." The FBI said members of a North Korean state-sponsored unit known as TraderTraitor were responsible for the Binance attack. Law enforcement had observed them converting the stolen assets to the cryptocurrency ethereum, and expected them to launder the assets further. Binance has said it covered most of the assets stolen from the platform by using company money. ($1 = 1,344.4300 won) (Reporting by Jack Kim, Kyu-seok Shim and Maggie Grether in Seoul; Editing by Ed Davies and Stephen Coates)

Η Ρωσία παρουσιάζει τις κινήσεις της Πιονγκγιάνγκ για ενίσχυση των στρατιωτικών της δυνατοτήτων ως «απολύτως νόμιμες και δικαιολογημένες», μετατοπίζοντας το βάρος της ευθύνης στην Ουάσιγκτον και τη Σεούλ. Πώς τροφοδοτούν οι ασκήσεις τις εντάσεις στην Κορεατική Χερσόνησο; Η εκπρόσωπος του ρωσικού Υπουργείου Εξωτερικών Μαρία Ζαχάροβα χαρακτήρισε τις ασκήσεις των ΗΠΑ και της Νότιας Κορέας «απροκάλυπτα προκλητικές», τονίζοντας ότι στοχεύουν σε εξάσκηση προληπτικών πληγμάτων κατά της Βόρειας Κορέας, ακόμη και με πυρηνικά όπλα. Κατά τη ρωσική ανάγνωση, η αυξανόμενη συχνότητα και κλίμακα των ασκήσεων, που πλέον εκτείνονται σε ξηρά, αέρα, θάλασσα και κυβερνοχώρο, διαμορφώνει μια μόνιμη κατάσταση στρατιωτικής πίεσης στην Πιονγκγιάνγκ. Η Μόσχα αναφέρεται συγκεκριμένα στις ασκήσεις «Iron Mace», «Hoguk» και «Freedom Flag», αλλά και στην τριμερή στρατιωτική συνεργασία με την Ιαπωνία, ως παράγοντες που ενισχύουν το αίσθημα περικύκλωσης της Βόρειας Κορέας. Σε αυτό το πλαίσιο, η Ρωσία καλεί τη Σεούλ «να σταματήσει άμεσα τα επικίνδυνα στρατιωτικά παιχνίδια και τις προκλήσεις, ιδιαίτερα στη ζώνη αποστρατιωτικοποίησης», υιοθετώντας ρητορική που μεταφέρει την ευθύνη της αποκλιμάκωσης στο στρατόπεδο των συμμάχων των ΗΠΑ. Πού στοχεύει η ρωσική υπεράσπιση της Βόρειας Κορέας; Η ρωσική στάση, που χαρακτηρίζει την ενίσχυση των στρατιωτικών ικανοτήτων της Βόρειας Κορέας ως «απολύτως νόμιμη και δικαιολογημένη», εντάσσεται σε ένα ευρύτερο γεωπολιτικό πλαίσιο αντιπαράθεσης με τη Δύση. Με αυτή τη διατύπωση, η Μόσχα επιχειρεί να απονομιμοποιήσει το επιχείρημα ότι η Πιονγκγιάνγκ αποτελεί τον κύριο αποσταθεροποιητικό παράγοντα στην περιοχή, προβάλλοντας αντ’ αυτού την αρχή της κυριαρχικής ασφάλειας κάθε κράτους. Η κριτική προς τις ΗΠΑ, τη Νότια Κορέα και την τριμερή συνεργασία με την Ιαπωνία αναδεικνύει την Κορεατική Χερσόνησο ως ακόμη ένα μέτωπο αντιπαράθεσης ανάμεσα σε Ρωσία και δυτικές δυνάμεις. Η ρωσική έκκληση για σεβασμό του «κυρίαρχου δικαιώματος της Πιονγκγιάνγκ να διασφαλίζει την ασφάλειά της με όλα τα διαθέσιμα μέσα» μεταφέρει τη συζήτηση από τη συμμόρφωση σε διεθνείς κανόνες στον συσχετισμό ισχύος και στην πολιτική αποτροπής. Τι σημαίνει για την Ελλάδα Για την Ελλάδα, η αναζωπύρωση των εντάσεων στην Κορεατική Χερσόνησο αποτελεί υπενθύμιση ότι η ασιατική αστάθεια επηρεάζει έμμεσα και την ευρωπαϊκή ασφάλεια, στην οποία η χώρα συμμετέχει μέσω της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης και του ΝΑΤΟ. Η όξυνση της αντιπαράθεσης Ρωσίας – Δύσης σε ένα ακόμη γεωγραφικό μέτωπο περιπλέκει το διπλωματικό περιβάλλον στο οποίο η Αθήνα καλείται να ισορροπήσει ανάμεσα στις συμμαχικές της υποχρεώσεις και στη διαχείριση των σχέσεων με τη Μόσχα. Σχόλιο : Η ρωσική επιλογή να υπερασπιστεί ανοιχτά τις στρατιωτικές κινήσεις της Βόρειας Κορέας δείχνει ότι κάθε περιφερειακή κρίση μετατρέπεται πλέον σε πεδίο ευρύτερης γεωπολιτικής αντιπαράθεσης, κάτι που καθιστά για την Ελλάδα ακόμη πιο απαιτητική την άσκηση μιας συνεκτικής, προβλέψιμης εξωτερικής πολιτικής στο πλαίσιο των συμμαχιών της. The timing is not coincidental: North Korea's GPS jamming operations surged 15-fold in a single year, from 39 documented incidents in 2023 to 578 in 2024, according to research by the Brussels School of Governance's Centre for Security, Diplomacy and Strategy .
https://www.techtimes.com/articles/32989.p2: That jamming surge is not a theoretical concern. A North Korean GPS jamming campaign from May 29 to June 2, 2025 — one of the most aggressive in recorded history — disrupted more than 500 aircraft and hundreds of ships navigating the Korean Peninsula's coastal waters. The civilian navigation systems aboard those aircraft and vessels depend on the same satellite signals as military assets. Until South Korea's own satellite navigation constellation comes online in 2035, the country faces more than a decade of continued vulnerability to the kind of electronic disruption it is now training to counter alongside allies.

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/col.p1: The long-standing debate over the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) is once again emerging as a contentious issue in the ROK-U.S. alliance. The Lee Jae Myung administration has repeatedly expressed its determination to accelerate the transfer, while the Trump administration remains reluctant, emphasizing the need to meet the agreed conditions. The fact that the Security Consultative Meeting (SCM), at which the two sides were expected to discuss and finalize a roadmap for the transfer, has been postponed until next year suggests that their differences remain unresolved. There is a real possibility that the OPCON issue could become a source of friction in the alliance.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/col.p2: The sensitivity and importance of this issue stem from its direct connection to two fundamental values: sovereignty and security. From the perspective of national sovereignty, the commander-in-chief should be able to exercise full command authority over the country's own armed forces. President Lee has also stressed that South Korea cannot continue to leave its military sovereignty in the hands of another country. From a security perspective, however, there are concerns that changing the command structure without adequate preparation could weaken deterrence. This is why meeting the conditions for the transfer has been given such strong emphasis. The tension between sovereignty and security has led to repeated delays over the years.

https://aninews.in/news/world/asia/mosco.p2: Moscow [ Russia ], November 4 (ANI): The Russia n Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a strong condemnation on Wednesday regarding the escalating tensions on the Korean Peninsula, directly placing the blame on ongoing joint military exercises conducted by the United States and South Korea. Addressing media inquiries, Russia n Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova warned that security dynamics in the subregion show "no sign of stabilising and continue to deteriorate," pointing to Washington and Seoul's expanding manoeuvres as the root driver of the crisis. According to Moscow, the joint war games near the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) represent overt aggression aimed at Pyongyang . "Of particular concern is that the situation is deteriorating amid ongoing large-scale military exercises conducted by the US and the Republic of Korea near the DPRK border," Zakharova stated. "These manoeuvres are overtly provocative. By the participants’ own admission, they are designed to rehearse pre-emptive strikes against the DPRK, including with nuclear weapons." Zakharova highlighted that these military manoeuvres are rapidly expanding across land, air, maritime, and cyber domains. She pointed specifically to recent operations such as the US-ROK Iron Mace command-post exercise, the ROK Hoguk exercise, US airborne operations behind simulated enemy lines, the joint Freedom Flag air exercise running through November 6, and the trilateral Freedom Edge exercises conducted in September alongside Japan . Refusing Seoul's attempts to hold North Korea responsible for the heightened regional friction, Moscow defended Pyongyang 's recent military actions as entirely consistent with international law.

https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articl.title: Moscow slams joint USSouth Korea drills as "provocative," defends North Korea's defensive right
https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articl.p1: Addressing media inquiries, Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova warned that security dynamics in the subregion show "no sign of stabilising and continue to deteriorate," pointing to Washington and Seoul's expanding manoeuvres as the root driver of the crisis. According to Moscow, the joint war games near the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) represent overt aggression aimed at Pyongyang. "Of particular concern is that the situation is deteriorating amid ongoing large-scale military exercises conducted by the US and the Republic of Korea near the DPRK border," Zakharova stated. "These manoeuvres are overtly provocative. By the participants own admission, they are designed to rehearse pre-emptive strikes against the DPRK, including with nuclear weapons." Zakharova highlighted that these military manoeuvres are rapidly expanding across land, air, maritime, and cyber domains. She pointed specifically to recent operations such as the US-ROK Iron Mace command-post exercise, the ROK Hoguk exercise, US airborne operations behind simulated enemy lines, the joint Freedom Flag air exercise running through November 6, and the trilateral Freedom Edge exercises conducted in September alongside Japan. Refusing Seoul's attempts to hold North Korea responsible for the heightened regional friction, Moscow defended Pyongyang's recent military actions as entirely consistent with international law. "In these circumstances, we regard the measures Pyongyang is taking to strengthen its security and defence capabilities as entirely lawful and justified, in full accordance with the right to self-defence enshrined in the UN Charter," Zakharova affirmed.Closing her statement, the Russian spokeswoman called on South Korea to immediately halt all provocative activities near the DMZ and abandon anti-Pyongyang rhetoric. "We urge Seoul to immediately cease its dangerous military games and provocations, particularly in the Demilitarised Zone, rather than seeking far-fetched pretexts for accusing the DPRK or making empty declarations about peace, and to respect Pyongyangs sovereign right to ensure its own security by all means available," she concluded. The United States, South Korea and Japan commenced a five-day trilateral military exercise in September, proceeding as planned despite recent reductions to key Seoul-Washington exercises following directives from US President Donald Trump. The multidomain Freedom Edge exercise initiated operations in international waters located east and south of Jeju Island, the South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced via an official press release. The three nations will leverage the drills to enhance operational capabilities and joint response capabilities across multiple domains, including maritime, air and cyber, while maintaining a robust and stable cooperative relationship, the JCS stated. (ANI)

https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CE%BD%CE%B.title: Νότια Κορέα ΗΠΑ σχέσεις μετά τις εκλογές
https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CE%BD%CE%B.p1: Νότια Κορέα ΗΠΑ παραμένουν, σύμφωνα με τη Σεούλ, σε τροχιά θεσμικής συνέχειας παρά την ήττα των Ρεπουμπλικανών στις ενδιάμεσες εκλογές. Η πρωθυπουργός Χαν Σέονγκ-σουκ μίλησε για περιορισμένες αλλαγές, υπογραμμίζοντας τη διακομματική στήριξη της συμμαχίας στην Ουάσινγκτον. Νότια Κορέα ΗΠΑ περιγράφονται από τη Σεούλ ως σταθερή συμμαχία, που δεν αναμένεται να επηρεαστεί ουσιαστικά από την ήττα των Ρεπουμπλικανών στις ενδιάμεσες εκλογές στις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες. Η πρωθυπουργός Χαν Σέονγκ-σουκ τόνισε ενώπιον της κοινοβουλευτικής επιτροπής προϋπολογισμού ότι δεν προβλέπει «πολύ μεγάλες αλλαγές» στις διμερείς σχέσεις. Πώς ερμηνεύει η Σεούλ το αποτέλεσμα για Νότια Κορέα ΗΠΑ; Η Χαν υπενθύμισε ότι και τα δύο μεγάλα κόμματα στις ΗΠΑ αντιμετωπίζουν τη συμμαχία με τη Νότια Κορέα ως στρατηγική προτεραιότητα, στοιχείο που λειτουργεί ως θεσμική «ασφάλεια» απέναντι στις εναλλαγές πλειοψηφιών στο Κογκρέσο. Η διακομματική αυτή συναίνεση επιτρέπει στη Σεούλ να προβάλλει εικόνα συνέχειας, παρά την ενίσχυση των Δημοκρατικών πέραν των προσδοκιών. Την ίδια στιγμή, η κυβέρνηση στη Νότια Κορέα δεν αντιμετωπίζει το αποτέλεσμα ως τυπική εξέλιξη, αλλά έχει ζητήσει από τα αρμόδια υπουργεία να επανεξετάσουν τις επιμέρους πτυχές της συνεργασίας μετά τις κάλπες. Η ανασκόπηση αυτή αφορά κυρίως τον συντονισμό σε θέματα ασφάλειας και προϋπολογισμού, καθώς το νέο Κογκρέσο θα έχει λόγο σε στρατιωτικές δαπάνες και διμερείς συμφωνίες. Τι δείχνει η θεσμική προσέγγιση της Νότιας Κορέας; Η επιλογή της Σεούλ να τονίσει τη συνέχεια αντί της αβεβαιότητας δείχνει μια στρατηγική ανάγνωσης των αμερικανικών θεσμών, πέρα από την εκλογική συγκυρία. Η Νότια Κορέα επενδύει στη λογική ότι η συμμαχία έχει ενσωματωθεί στη δομή της αμερικανικής πολιτικής, άρα δύσκολα ανατρέπεται από μια μεταβολή κοινοβουλευτικών συσχετισμών. Παράλληλα, η παραδοχή της Χαν ότι η νίκη των Δημοκρατικών ήταν ισχυρότερη του αναμενομένου αποκαλύπτει ότι η Σεούλ παρακολουθεί στενά τις εσωτερικές ισορροπίες στην Ουάσινγκτον. Η αξιολόγηση του αποτελέσματος από τα υπουργεία λειτουργεί ως προληπτικός μηχανισμός προσαρμογής, ώστε η Νότια Κορέα να μπορεί να κινηθεί έγκαιρα αν αλλάξουν προτεραιότητες στην αμερικανική νομοθετική ατζέντα. Τι σημαίνει για την Ελλάδα Για την Ελλάδα, η επιλογή της Νότιας Κορέας να επενδύει στη θεσμική συνέχεια των σχέσεών της με τις ΗΠΑ αναδεικνύει τη σημασία των σταθερών, διακομματικών δεσμών με την Ουάσινγκτον. Σε μια περίοδο όπου η Αθήνα ενισχύει τη δική της στρατηγική συνεργασία με τις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες, η κορεατική στάση λειτουργεί ως υπενθύμιση ότι οι αντοχές μιας συμμαχίας κρίνονται στο πώς θωρακίζεται απέναντι στις εναλλαγές εξουσίας. Σχόλιο : Η ελληνική διπλωματία έχει κάθε λόγο να παρακολουθεί πώς χώρες όπως η Νότια Κορέα «θεσμοθετούν» τη σχέση τους με τις ΗΠΑ, ώστε να αντλήσει πρακτικά διδάγματα για τη δική της στρατηγική. Η εμπειρία της Σεούλ δείχνει ότι η έγκαιρη προσαρμογή στα εκλογικά δεδομένα της Ουάσινγκτον μπορεί να ενισχύσει, αντί να αποδυναμώσει, τη διαχρονικότητα μιας συμμαχίας. https://aninews.in/news/business/global-.title: Global refinery inputs fall 6% in Q2 as Middle East conflict disrupts crude supplies
https://aninews.in/news/business/global-.p2: New Delhi [India], November 5 (ANI): Global crude oil refinery inputs declined sharply in the second quarter of 2026 following the outbreak of conflict in the Middle East, with disruptions to crude supplies through the Strait of Hormuz weighing on refining activity across major Asian and Middle Eastern economies, according to the US Energy Information Administration (EIA). Global refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d), or 6 per cent, in the April-June quarter compared with the previous quarter, data from energy intelligence firm Kpler showed. Refinery throughput subsequently recovered by 1.8 million b/d in the third quarter as refiners adjusted to changing trade flows and alternative supply routes. The decline was particularly pronounced in countries heavily dependent on crude supplies passing through the Strait of Hormuz. China recorded the largest reduction, with refinery inputs falling by 2.1 million b/d in the second quarter and a further 0.8 million b/d in the third quarter. India, South Korea and Japan together saw crude oil inputs decline by more than 1 million b/d in the second quarter, although they recovered by 0.8 million b/d in the following quarter.

https://thehayride.com/2026/11/louisiana.title: Louisiana unemployment insurance claims decline for 11 consecutive weeks
https://thehayride.com/2026/11/louisiana.p1: (The Center Square) – Louisiana’s continued unemployment insurance claims declined for the 11th consecutive week in October, falling roughly 33% below last year’s levels, though state officials could not quantify how much the decline has saved taxpayers. The number of continued unemployment insurance weeks claimed fell to 5,295 for the week ending Oct. 17, down from 5,423 the previous week and 7,898 during the comparable week in 2025, according to Louisiana Works, the state’s workforce development agency. Initial unemployment claims, which measure new applications for benefits, also declined, falling to 1,179 from 1,261 the previous week. That represented a 25% decrease from the 1,581 claims filed during the same week last year. Gov. Jeff Landry’s office attributed the sustained decline to the administration’s economic development efforts and major corporate investments announced in Louisiana. “Louisiana’s 11th consecutive week of declining unemployment insurance claims is no accident,” the governor’s office said in a statement to The Center Square. “This is a direct correlation to the booming economy we are seeing take shape in all 64 parishes throughout Louisiana.” The administration pointed to investments by Hyundai, Meta and SpaceX, which have collectively announced plans to spend more than $150 billion in the state and create thousands of jobs. SpaceX, for example is projecting 3,000 direct jobs over the next decade for their Vermillion parish ‘spaceport’. Construction is expected to begin by the end of 2027, with the first launch targeted for 2029. Hyundai’s proposed $5.8 billion steel facility in Ascension Parish is expected to create 1,400 direct jobs, and Meta’s expanding data center development in Richland Parish is projected to support approximately 1,000 permanent jobs and thousands of construction positions. The unemployment insurance figures alone do not establish whether those investments contributed to the decline in claims. Louisiana Works said it could not quantify the state’s financial savings from the decline. The state’s broader labor market data also show improvement, although the picture is more complicated than the weekly claims figures suggest. Louisiana’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate fell to 4% in September, down from 4.2% in August, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. The state had approximately 2.02 million employed residents in September, slightly fewer than in August, while its labor force also contracted. Meanwhile, Louisiana employers reported approximately 2.024 million nonfarm payroll jobs in September, an increase of 1.8% from a year earlier. Construction employment grew nearly 14% over the same period. Advertisement Advertisement Facebook Twitter 0 shares

I sent it again, thinking maybe the network dropped something, and it arrived just as soft. The problem wasn’t my camera or my connection. Google Messages compresses every photo before sending it by default, and the app never tells you it’s doing it. One setting I’d never noticed controls this behavior, and changing it fixed every photo I’ve sent since.
https://www.makeuseof.com/stop-google-me.p2: Google Messages shrinks every photo in two stages before sending it. It downscales the image first, capping it at roughly 2,048 pixels vertically. Most flagship phones today shoot at 50 megapixels or higher, and that cap brings a photo down to roughly 2 MP. Then it runs JPEG compression on top, squeezing the file from several MB down to a few hundred KB. Fine texture like grass and distant signage is the first to go, flattening into blurry patches.

https://www.siliconindia.com/news/genera.title: India Flags China-Linked AI Tools in Cyberattacks Targeting Financial Institutions
https://www.siliconindia.com/news/genera.p1: India has raised concerns over the use of China-linked artificial intelligence (AI) tools in cyberattacks targeting financial institutions. The warning highlights growing cybersecurity risks, potential threats to banking infrastructure, and the need for stronger digital defenses as attackers increasingly use AI-powered tools to exploit vulnerabilities.
https://www.siliconindia.com/news/genera.p2: India's cybersecurity authorities have identified an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven hacking group targeting financial institutions , raising concerns about the growing use of automated cyberattack tools against banks, fintech companies and other financial service providers. The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has named the group "Crafty Falcon" and identified four tools associated with its operations, including at least two that security researchers link to China. According to an advisory issued, Crafty Falcon has breached non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), fintech firms and cryptocurrency exchanges. The development adds India to a growing list of countries facing cyberattacks that use publicly available AI tools to automate malicious activities and exploit vulnerabilities in financial infrastructure. CERT-In says the attackers use artificial intelligence to identify targets, assess weaknesses and automate intrusion attempts 'at machine speed'. The agency describes the threat as 'active and ongoing', highlighting the need for financial institutions to strengthen their cybersecurity frameworks and improve their ability to detect suspicious transactions and unauthorized system access. The advisory identifies four tools used in the campaign: ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn and CyberStrikeAI. Security researchers associate at least two of these tools with China. Cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike has reported that China-made ARTEX features in attacks against South Korean banks since late September. The firm also links the tool to an espionage campaign targeting more than 200 organizations across at least 14 countries.

https://timesofoman.com/article/178878-u.title: US asks China to uphold Busan trade deal commitments - Times of Oman
https://timesofoman.com/article/178878-u.p1: Top officials of United States President Donald Trump's administration have called on China to "fully and immediately" implement its commitments under a 2025 trade agreement between the two nations, including on rare earth and other critical minerals. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer on Friday held a videoconference with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng on the trade and economic relationship between Washington and Beijing, a statement from Greer's office said. Greer "emphasized the critical importance of China taking concrete actions to fully implement its past commitments, particularly as they relate to agricultural purchases, rare earths, and other critical minerals.” it added. The US-China trade agreement The US officials were referring to an accord reached between the world's two largest economies in 2025 in a meeting between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in South Korea's Busan, on the sidelines of  an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. The deal had been reached during a period that saw the two countries exchange tariff escalations prompted by Trump's wider tariffs policy, which particularly targeted China, among other countries. The accord capped US tariffs on Chinese goods —  enforced during Trump's second stint as president —  at about 20%. China agreed to buy 25 million metric tons of US soybeans for the next three years. Beijing also said it would keep China's rare earth exports flowing, suspending new export curbs. The minerals are critical for the technological industry, and the Trump administration has in the past complained that Beijing was not meeting its commitments regarding supply. "The Trump Administration will continue pursuing policies that benefit American workers, farmers, and businesses and strengthen our economic and national security,” Bessent wrote on X after the high-level call. China raises concern over US trade restrictions He, who is Beijing's lead negotiator on trade ties with the US, during Friday's interaction expressed  "serious concern" over recent US trade restrictions targeting his country, Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported. The report did not elaborate which measure the vice premier was referring to. But both parties agreed to "continuously strengthen cooperation”and "properly manage differences" to promote a "stable" US-China trade relationship, Xinhua said. The Busan trade deal  at first covered only one year, but the US and China extended their trade pact until January 10 next year, as  Trump hosted Xi at the White House in September. The two leaders are expected to meet again at the upcoming APEC forum in Shenzhen, China, slated from November 18 to 19. Meanwhile, in a separate development, China has confirmed for the first time that it is discussing a historic trilateral summit of Xi, Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC gathering. China "is in communication with relevant parties regarding a meeting between the three heads of state,” Mao Ning, a spokesperson for the Chinese Foreign Ministry, said at a media briefing in Beijing this week.

https://www.etnews.com/20261108000029.p1: “한국 라면은 단맛과 매운맛, 감칠맛이 한데 어우러져 있어요.” 6일 '2026 구미라면축제' 개막일에 찾은 경북 구미역 앞. 행사장 입구에서 만난 미국인 제빵사 린지는 한국 라면의 매력을 이렇게 설명했다. 행사장 안에서 이색 라면을 맛보던 독일인 20대 청년 앰버는 “전에 먹어본 적 없는 맛”이라며 “풍미가 풍부하다”고 말했다. 구미역 앞 약 475m 거리가 외국인들도 찾아오는 라면 체험장으로 바뀌었다.
https://www.etnews.com/20261108000029.p2: 린지는 외국인들이 자신만의 라면 요리로 실력을 겨루는 축제 부대행사 '글로벌 라면 챌린지' 참가자다. 지난해 한국에서 다른 경연에 참가했던 인연으로 이번 축제를 소개받았다. 다음 날 본선을 앞둔 그는 “다양한 종류의 라면을 맛볼 기회가 있다는 게 좋다”며 “한국 음식을 더 배우고 싶다”고 말했다. 앰버는 대구에서 한국어를 배우다 선생님의 초대로 일행 두 명과 함께 왔다. 이들은 매운맛이 부담스러워 맵지 않은 메뉴를 골랐다고 했다. 한국 라면을 즐기는 방식은 매운맛 도전을 넘어 다양한 요리를 맛보고 조리법을 배우는 경험으로 넓어지고 있었다. 올해로 5회째인 구미라면축제는 국내 신라면 생산량의 약 75%를 담당하는 농심 구미공장이 있다는 지역적 특색에서 출발했다. 농심은 2022년 첫해부터 핵심 파트너로 참여해 공장 직송 라면과 브랜드 체험 콘텐츠를 지원하고 있다. 행사장 초입에 위치한 '신라면 분식' 부스는 서울 성수동 농심 안테나숍을 통째로 축제장에 옮겨온 듯했다. 이 곳에서는 면과 스프, 건더기를 고르고 포장을 꾸며 자신만의 라면을 가져갈 수 있었다. 라면레스토랑에서 지역 음식점들이 선보인 메뉴에서는 올해 축제의 키워드인 '프리미엄'이 드러났다. 바지락과 전복, 한우와 갈비, 통오징어와 문어, 자연산 송이와 능이버섯까지 라면에 곁들이는 재료가 다채로웠다. 라면레스토랑 25곳과 라면트럭 8대 등 음식점 33곳이 당일 생산한 라면에 각자의 재료와 조리법을 더했다. 공장에서 직송한 '갓 튀긴 라면'을 판매하는 '갓랜드'에도 발길이 이어졌다. 현장에서 만난 구미에 거주하는 60대 부부는 개막일 오전부터 3시간 반을 기다려 '갓 튀긴 라면백'을 샀다고 했다. 당일 생산한 라면을 담아 등에 멜 수 있도록 만든 가방이다. 라면을 가득 담은 모습은 '라면거북이'라는 별칭을 얻으며 인증사진 소재가 됐다.

https://www.etnews.com/20261108000012.p1: 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 장녀 매디슨 황 엔비디아 옴니버스·로보틱스 제품 마케팅 수석이사가 한국 방문을 하루 앞두고 일정을 전격 취소했다. 공식적으로는 가족 관련 사유가 제시됐지만, 젠슨 황 CEO를 둘러싼 중국 정보기관 연루 의혹이 잇따라 보도된 시점과 맞물리면서 취소 배경에 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 7일 정부와 정보기술(IT) 업계에 따르면 매디슨 황 수석이사는 당초 8일 한국에 입국해 9~10일 서울 코엑스에서 열리는 '엔비디아 AI 데이 서울 2026'에 참석할 예정이었다. 방한 기간 배경훈 부총리 겸 과학기술정보통신부 장관을 비롯한 정부 관계자들과의 면담도 계획돼 있었지만, 일정이 취소되면서 관련 협의도 무산됐다. 취소 사유는 가족 관련 문제로 전해졌다. 다만 구체적인 내용은 공개되지 않았다. 특히 이번 결정이 최근 미국 언론을 통해 제기된 젠슨 황 CEO와 중국 정보기관의 연계 의혹 보도 직후 이뤄졌다는 점에서 두 사안의 연관성을 둘러싼 관측도 나오고 있다. 다만 현재까지 방한 취소와 해당 의혹 사이의 직접적인 관련성을 뒷받침하는 근거는 확인되지 않았다. 파이낸셜타임스(FT)는 7일(현지시간) 미국 당국자들이 젠슨 황 CEO와 싱가포르 데이터센터 기업 메가스피드의 임원 출신 앨리스 황(중국명 황러)이 연인 관계였던 것으로 판단하고 있다고 보도했다. 미국 정보당국은 앨리스 황이 중국의 핵심 정보기관인 국가안전부(MSS)에 포섭됐을 가능성을 의심하고 있으며, 중국 측이 그를 통해 엔비디아 관련 정보를 수집하고 첨단 인공지능(AI) 반도체의 중국 공급에 영향력을 행사하려 했다는 의혹도 제기됐다. 앞서 뉴욕타임스(NYT)도 미국 정보당국이 앨리스 황의 중국 정보기관 연계 가능성을 조사했다고 보도했다. 관련 첩보는 미국 정부 고위 당국자들에게 전달된 것으로 알려졌다. 미 하원 외교위원장과 중국특위 위원장, 정보위원장도 지난 4일 젠슨 황 CEO에게 서한을 보내 관련 사안에 대한 비공개 브리핑을 요구했다. 엔비디아는 젠슨 황 CEO와 앨리스 황의 관계 및 미국 정부의 관련 메모에 대한 논평을 거부했다. 다만 젠슨 황 CEO가 매년 수천 명의 고객사 임원들과 만난다며 앨리스 황과의 접촉 역시 통상적인 업무 활동의 일부라는 입장을 밝혔다. 현재까지 젠슨 황 CEO가 앨리스 황의 정보 활동을 인지하거나 관여했다는 사실은 확인되지 않았다. 매디슨 황의 갑작스러운 방한 취소는 엔비디아와 한국 기업들의 협력 확대 측면에서도 주목된다. 그는 올해 4월 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스, LG전자, 현대자동차, 두산로보틱스 등 국내 주요 기업들과 만나 피지컬 AI와 로보틱스 분야의 협력 가능성을 논의했다. 8월에는 LG전자 양재 연구개발 캠퍼스를 방문해 로봇 데이터팩토리 구축 현장을 둘러보기도 했다. 이번 방한에서도 국내 기업 및 정부와의 후속 협력 논의가 예상됐다. 엔비디아가 AI 반도체를 넘어 로봇과 산업 자동화 분야로 사업 영역을 확대하는 상황에서 한국 기업들과의 협력은 전략적 의미가 있기 때문이다. 매디슨 황의 불참에도 엔비디아 AI 데이 서울 2026 행사는 예정대로 진행될 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 방한 취소의 구체적인 배경이 공개되지 않으면서, 최근 불거진 젠슨 황 CEO 관련 의혹과 이번 결정 사이에 어떤 관계가 있는지를 둘러싼 관심은 당분간 이어질 전망이다. 이상목 기자 mrlsm@etnews.com

http://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/08/.title: Electric auto rickshaws reshape India's roads | The Peninsula Qatar
http://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/08/.p1: Photograph taken on October 22, 2026, shows a customer driving his newly purchased Mahindra UDO electric three wheeler in India's Telangana state. (Photo by Noah Seelam / AFP)
http://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/08/.p2: Hyderabad, India: Every 90 seconds, an electric three-wheeler rolls off the production line at an Indian factory, underscoring a transformation that has made the country the largest market for battery-powered auto rickshaws. At a bustling plant run by Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, workers and robots fit cells into battery packs, attach body panels to metal frames and fix wheels into place, racing to meet demand for vehicles known for navigating the chaotic streets of the world's most populous country. In September, more than one in two new three-wheelers sold in India was electric, compared with about 8.5 percent of cars and 11.6 percent of two-wheelers, reaffirming its position as the world's largest electric three-wheeler market. "Our company has grown six times in its EV penetration in the last five years," said Mahindra LMM's chief executive Suman Mishra. She said adoption accelerated over the past two years as government subsidies, improving vehicle quality and falling operating costs combined to make ownership more attractive. E-rickshaws first appeared on New Delhi's streets more than a decade ago, often assembled in roadside workshops using Chinese-made batteries fitted to modified pedal-powered tricycles. But the sector has since eaten into the market for sturdier fossil-fuel-powered three-wheelers, becoming a major industry as manufacturers such as Mahindra expand their share. The shift has altered the look and sound of Indian cities. Across northern India, e-rickshaws now queue outside railway stations and bustling markets, replacing the thumping noise of traditional "tuk-tuks". Fuel savings Mahindra is one of 15 finalists shortlisted for the environmental Earthshot Prize, to be awarded in Mumbai by Prince William on November 17. For many drivers, however, earnings outweigh environmental benefits. "Money is coming straight into my pocket," said Afroz Alam, a 31-year-old driver in Hyderabad who switched from a gas-powered model to an EV this year. The cost of charging his vehicle saves him several hundred rupees a day, helping repay the loan he took out to buy the more expensive electric version. "It may seem expensive, but then it levels out with the gas money you no longer have to pay," he told AFP. Analysts agree economics is the key driver of adoption, with falling costs of batteries and rising fuel prices widening the advantage of e-vehicles. Indian think-tank CEEW estimated in 2025 that petrol three-wheelers cost more than twice as much per kilometre to operate over their lifetime as EVs. "Rickshaws, which operate continuously throughout the day, accumulate fuel savings rapidly," said Bidisha Bhattacharya of the Delhi-based Chintan Research Foundation. The trend has also been welcomed by policymakers in India, which imports most of its oil and natural gas and has scrambled to manage energy costs, since conflict in the Middle East erupted in February. Climate think-tank Ember said India consumes less transport fuel per capita than China did at a comparable income level in 2012, helped by the spread of cheap solar power and declining battery costs. "In the race to curb oil imports, India is already far ahead," Ember said in a recent report. Yet hurdles remain, with adoption uneven across the country. 'Battery will fail' E-rickshaws are common in cities such as Lucknow but far less visible in Mumbai, where limited parking and charging infrastructure complicate ownership. "In Mumbai, there is no parking at all," Mishra said. "So you can park on the side of the road for a (fuel-run) vehicle, but how do you do it for an EV when you have to charge it?" Supply chains pose another challenge. Last year, China restricted exports of rare-earth magnets, an essential component in electric motors, forcing several Indian automakers to cut or suspend production. New Delhi has responded by promoting domestic manufacturing, including battery cells, most of which are still imported from China and South Korea. "Two players are very close to commercialisation of their cells in India. We have to be patient," Mishra said. The bigger question is whether the success of e-rickshaws can be replicated in private cars and, eventually, trucks, which consume far more fuel. Bhattacharya said commercial fleets could provide the next breakthrough. When taxis transition to electric power, she said, they would help build the charging networks and consumer confidence. For drivers already making the switch, the argument remains simple. "They keep saying the battery will fail," said Mohammad Ali, 26, who bought an e-rickshaw this year. "Do a trial, take the vehicle and do it for a day. They don't know yet how much money we are saving."

https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.title: [심호섭의전쟁이야기] 러일전쟁, 1905년은 누구의 역사인가 | 세계일보
https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p1: 얼마 전 러일전쟁 칼럼을 썼다. 이에 평소 내 칼럼을 읽는 한 독자가 아쉬움을 전해왔다. 러일전쟁이 을사늑약과 함께 우리가 식민지로 전락하는 계기가 되었는데, 그 이야기가 부족했다는 것이다. 맞는 지적이었다. 이번 칼럼은 그 독자에게 보내는 답장이다. 러일전쟁의 중심에는 한반도가 있었다. 일본과 러시아는 한국과 만주의 권익을 놓고 흥정했다. 이른바 ‘한만교환론’이다. 일본은 한국에서의 우월한 지위를 인정받는 대신 만주에서 러시아의 이익을 인정하려 했다. 러시아는 만주의 권익을 지키면서 한국에서 일본의 군사 활동을 제한하려 했다. 1903년에는 북위 39도선 이북을 중립지대로 만들자는 제안까지 내놓았다. 정작 대한제국은 협상 테이블에 없었다.
https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p2: 협상이 결렬되자 일본은 전쟁을 택했다. 1904년 2월 뤼순 기습과 동시에 일본군은 인천에 상륙해 서울로 들어왔다. 인천 앞바다에서는 러시아 군함 두 척이 일본 함대에 패했다. 전쟁은 한반도에서도 시작된 것이다. 대한제국의 중립 선언은 소용없었다. 일본은 한일의정서를 강요해 한반도를 군사적으로 이용했다. 일본군은 압록강으로 진격했고 경의선을 군용철도로 건설했다. 땅이 수용되고 한국인들이 전쟁에 동원됐다. 독도도 예외가 아니었다. 1905년 2월 일본은 러시아 함대 감시에 유리한 독도의 군사적 가치에 주목하고 자신의 영토로 편입시켰다. 전쟁 막바지인 1905년 7월, 가쓰라·태프트 밀약에서 미국 측은 일본의 한국 지배를 사실상 용인했다. 8월에는 영국이 제2차 영일동맹을 통해 일본의 한국 내 우월한 지위를 인정했고, 9월 포츠머스조약에서 패전국 러시아도 이를 받아들였다. 일본은 러시아로부터 전쟁배상금을 얻지 못했지만, 한국에서는 외교권을 빼앗았다. 11월17일 을사늑약이 강요되자 ‘황성신문’에는 장지연의 ‘시일야방성대곡’이 실렸고, 민영환은 자결로 항거했다. 일본에 1905년은 열강의 반열에 오른 승리의 해였다. 러시아에는 패배와 혁명의 해였고, 강화를 중재한 미국의 루스벨트는 이듬해 노벨평화상을 받았다. 하지만 우리에게는 국권 피탈의 해였다. 누구의 경험에 주목하느냐에 따라 보이는 역사는 달라진다. 나는 일본이 어떻게 이겼는지를 물었고, 독자는 그 승리의 대가를 누가 치렀는지를 물었다. 다시 보니 두 질문은 따로 있지 않았다. 일본의 승리 뒤에는 한국의 땅과 노동, 침해된 주권이 있었다. 누가 왜 어떻게 전쟁에서 승리했는지를 밝히는 일도 중요하지만, 승자의 성취만으로 전쟁의 역사가 완성되지는 않는다. 익숙한 자리에서 벗어나 타인의 눈으로 과거를 바라보는 것. 한 독자의 아쉬움이 내게 다시금 일깨워준 역사 공부의 기본이다. 심호섭 육군사관학교 교수·군사사학과

https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articl.p1: The company has been installing manufacturing equipment, setting up production lines and conducting performance checks at the facility, with trial operations potentially beginning around mid-to-late December, the report said, citing industry sources. Samsung has not confirmed a specific date for the trial run. Samsung Austin Semiconductor, the company's US manufacturing subsidiary, is also recruiting engineers specialising in etching, metallisation and ion implantation, along with technical instructors who will train new employees. These preparations follow Samsung's confirmation last month that its first Taylor plant is expected to become fully operational by the end of this year. Samsung spokesperson Michele Glaze confirmed the timeline in late October, while the company has separately indicated that production at the facility will ramp up in 2027. The trial operations will involve testing manufacturing equipment and production processes before commercial manufacturing begins. Samsung will also need to stabilise production yields, which are critical for manufacturing chips using its advanced 2-nanometre technology. However, the project has since been delayed by about two years. The company is also expected to begin construction of a second plant in Taylor this month. Samsung had announced in July that the second facility would enter mass production in 2030. According to industry sources cited by The Korea Herald, Samsung has also secured orders to manufacture logic base dies for high-bandwidth memory chips destined for AMD and Nvidia at the second plant. However, these reported contracts have not been publicly confirmed. Samsung remains the second-largest player in the global contract chipmaking market, trailing Taiwan-based TSMC by a significant margin. According to market researcher TrendForce, Samsung held a 5.9 per cent share of global foundry revenue in the second quarter, compared with TSMC's 72.5 per cent. The upcoming trial operations at the Taylor facility mark an important step in Samsung's efforts to expand its chip manufacturing operations in the United States, with commercial production expected to ramp up in 2027. https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p2: 즈비그뉴 브레진스키의 경고가 떠오른다. 지미 카터 행정부의 국가안보보좌관을 지낸 브레진스키는 1997년 출간한 저서 ‘거대한 체스판’에서 한국을 우크라이나, 이란 등과 함께 ‘지정학적 중추 국가(geopolitical pivot)’로 분류했다. 스스로 판을 흔들 힘은 없지만, 그 위치 때문에 패권국에 영향을 미치는 나라다. 그가 꼽은 중추 국가 가운데 우크라이나와 이란은 지금 전쟁터가 됐다. 그는 주한미군 없는 통일 한국이 중국의 확고한 정치적 영향권, 혹은 중국의 권위가 교묘하게 존중되는 권역 안으로 기울어질 가능성이 크다고 봤다. 통일 이전이라도 동맹이 느슨해지면 같은 일이 벌어질 수 있다. 워싱턴이 경계하는 대목이다. 중국 쪽으로 기울었다가 낭패를 당한 일이 있다. 2015년 9월3일 박근혜 대통령이 베이징 천안문 망루에 올라 시진핑 중국 국가주석, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령과 나란히 서서 중국의 전승절 열병식을 지켜봤을 때다. 박 대통령은 중국의 대북 영향력을 활용하려는 계산이었지만, 워싱턴의 경계심만 키웠을 뿐 실익은 챙기지 못했다. 이듬해 1월 북한이 4차 핵실험을 강행하자 시 주석은 한 달 가까이 박 대통령의 전화조차 받지 않았고, 한·중 국방장관 핫라인도 먹통이었다. 사드 배치를 결정하자 돌아온 건 ‘한한령(限韓令)’이었다. 이재명 대통령은 지난해 8월 “외교에서 친중·혐중이 어디 있냐”고 했다. 한·미동맹이 외교의 근간이지만 중국과 절연하고 살 수는 없다는 취지였다. 틀린 말이 아니다. 윤석열정부의 가치외교가 한·중 관계를 필요 이상으로 얼어붙게 만든 것도 사실이다. 그러나 외교에선 우리의 의도보다 상대의 인식이 더 중요할 때가 많다. 우리 쪽에서 빌미를 준 일도 적지 않다. 올 초 서해에서 주한미군 F-16과 중국 전투기가 대치하자 우리 군은 주한미군사령관에게 항의했다. 동맹이 대중 견제 훈련에 제동을 건 모양새가 됐다. 미군 시설이 있는 광주 군공항 부지를 느닷없이 반도체 공장 부지로 정하자, 미국 당국자는 “일본으로 가라는 말이냐”며 격앙된 반응을 보였다고 한다. 사안마다 우리 나름의 사정이 있을 것이다. 하지만 점이 모이면 선이 된다. 워싱턴은 그 선 위에서 한 세대 전 경고를 떠올리고 있을지 모른다. 한·미가 불화하는 와중에 체스판의 다른 말들은 빠르게 진영을 짜고 있다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장은 단둥을 찾아 ‘피로 맺은 조·중 친선’을 과시했다. 북·러는 군사협력을 제도화하는 단계로 들어섰다. 패권국 사이에서 국익을 저울질하는 것은 중추 국가의 생존 조건이지만, 발 디딜 곳이 있어야 저울질도 가능하다. 실용외교는 동맹을 저울에 올려놓는 게 아니라, 동맹 위에 서서 중국을 상대하는 것이다. 한·미동맹이라는 발판이 흔들리면 중국도 한국을 존중하지 않는다. 물론 워싱턴도 동맹을 압박의 대상으로만 다뤄선 안 된다. 균열을 반길 쪽은 베이징과 평양이다. 30년 전 브레진스키의 경고를 한국 스스로 입증하는 일은 없어야 한다.

https://aninews.in/news/business/nvidia-.p2: Seoul [South Korea], November 9 (ANI): South Korean semiconductor manufacturers Samsung Electronics and SK hynix could face potential increases in export compliance burdens following scrutiny over Nvidia's artificial intelligence chip distribution channels linked to China, according to a news report by The Korea Herald. The developments emerged after reports surfaced regarding Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang maintaining a personal relationship with a businesswoman suspected of links to Chinese intelligence services. The situation prompted fresh regulatory attention toward corporate measures against espionage and the diversion of advanced computing components. Any resulting measures introduced by United States authorities threaten to affect domestic suppliers of high-bandwidth memory chips, which serve as essential components within Nvidia's AI accelerator hardware. United States authorities, however, announced no fresh regulatory curbs regarding the matter. The inquiry focused on Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and former executive at Singapore-headquartered data firm Megaspeed. United States authorities initiated an investigation into Megaspeed during 2024 over allegations involving the transfer of restricted hardware into China. While United States investigators examined potential recruitment by Chinese intelligence agencies, investigators established no definitive findings, and Nvidia maintained that previous engagements remained routine commercial matters. In a communication addressed to corporate staff, the Nvidia chief executive addressed the personal matter directly. "I was unfaithful to my wife," Jensen Huang stated. In the same communication, the chief executive offered apologies to his family while committing to full cooperation with an ongoing internal review. As per the news report, independent directors on Nvidia's board enlisted external legal counsel to review whether foreign intelligence entities targeted the executive. The board stated that no evidence indicated national security or proprietary corporate data suffered compromises, expressing continued support for the chief executive in his current role. Meanwhile, three United States House committee chairs scheduled a closed-door inquiry session for November 18 to review the contacts and security frameworks.

https://www.etnews.com/20261110000499.p1: 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO) 젠슨 황이 여성 임원 앨리스 황과 다정하게 포즈를 취하고 볼에 입을 맞추는 장면이 담긴 과거 영상이 다시 주목받고 있다. 당시 두 사람의 모습을 촬영한 인물은 젠슨 황의 장녀 매디슨 황인 것으로 알려졌다. 10일 엑스(X·옛 트위터) 등 SNS에는 젠슨 황이 2025년 5월 22일 대만 타이베이의 식당 산류스푸(三六食府)를 방문했을 당시 영상이 확산했다. 영상에는 업무 만찬 도중 젠슨 황이 앨리스 황을 옆으로 불러 허리를 감싸고 함께 서 있는 모습이 담겼다. 젠슨 황이 앨리스 황의 볼에 입을 맞추는 장면도 포착됐다. 두 사람의 모습을 카메라에 담은 사람은 매디슨 황이었다. 당시 현지 언론에 따르면 매디슨 황은 예비 남편 카프레즈와 함께 같은 식당에 있었다. 앨리스 황과 매디슨 황이 대화를 나누는 모습도 목격됐으며, 매디슨 황은 만찬 참석자들의 사진을 촬영한 것으로 전해졌다. 앨리스 황은 싱가포르 데이터센터 기업 메가스피드 인터내셔널의 임원 출신이다. 최근 외신들은 그가 중국과 연계된 스파이 활동에 관여했을 가능성을 제기하며 젠슨 황과의 관계를 보도했다. 첨단 AI 반도체 관련 정보와 미국 행정부 동향을 수집하기 위해 젠슨 황에게 접근했다는 의혹도 제기됐다. 한편 엔비디아 수석이사로 재직 중인 매디슨 황은 당초 서울 코엑스에서 열린 '엔비디아 AI 데이 서울 2026'에 참석할 예정이었으나 방한 일정을 취소했다. 이를 두고 부친을 둘러싼 최근 논란과 관련이 있는 것 아니냐는 관측이 나왔다. 엔비디아 관계자는 매디슨 황의 행사 불참 배경에 대해 “답변하기 어렵다”고 밝혔다. 이상목 기자 mrlsm@etnews.com

https://www.brownpoliticalreview.org/wor.title: Enshrined Conflict: The Paradox of the Yasukuni Shrine - Brown Political Review
https://www.brownpoliticalreview.org/wor.p1: The 1946 Tokyo War Crimes Trials , carried out by the Allied powers during postwar occupation, marked one of the first attempts to reckon with the atrocities committed by the Japanese Army during the Second World War. 28 men, many of whom were architects of the war, were indicted on charges of “Class A” war crimes for directing aggression that led to crimes against humanity. The trials represented an initial but important effort to reconcile a violence-filled past waged across East Asia. However, the legacy of the trials became far more complicated 30 years later, when 14 Class A criminals were enshrined in the Yasukuni shrine—a monument in the heart of Tokyo meant to honor those who gave their lives in service to the Japanese military. Since then, the shrine has been the subject of heated debate and constant controversy. After all, the 14 men were responsible for millions of deaths. The shrine also honors 2.5 million others who gave their lives in service of Japan throughout history, many of whom never saw the battlefield. As such, visits have been justified as an important remembrance for all of those who gave their life for the nation, a remembrance that should not be diluted by the inclusion of a small percentage of war criminals. At first glance, the shrine seems to propose a straightforward moral tension: how should a nation honor sacrifice while acknowledging horrific wrongdoing in its past? But this framing is incomplete. Controversy around Yasukuni persists because it attempts to serve two legitimate but ultimately opposing purposes. As a Shinto landmark, it seeks to nonjudgementally honor the dead and provide the living with a means to fulfill religious obligations; as a political symbol, it appears to affirm a hypernationalist, negationist, and revisionist view of history that at best denies and at worst glorifies past atrocities. As long as the shrine is asked to serve this dual function, any conflict surrounding it will remain irresolvable.
https://www.brownpoliticalreview.org/wor.p2: Yasukuni—which translates to “to preserve peace for the entire nation”—is a Shinto shrine, placing it within a religious framework that does not and cannot make moral distinctions between the dead. Shinto is Japan’s indigenous religion , centered around the worship of divine spirits. The shrine was established in 1869 by Emperor Meiji in the wake of a civil war to honor those who died and gave their souls for the Emperor. In Shinto belief, the dead become Kami , a rough equivalent to the word “spirit” or “deity.” Crucially, Shinto followers see death as inherently tragic no matter what, and believe there is no evaluative judgment of the dead or delineation into heaven or hell. On the contrary, it is up to the living, through rituals and worship, to ensure a peaceful transition and a fruitful afterlife for all of the dead and to maintain harmony between the living and spiritual realms. Within this logic, the enshrinement of war criminals in Yasukuni is not necessarily a statement on morality, history, or national memory; it is simply the fulfillment of a religious obligation to the communal war dead, regardless of the actions of specific individuals within that group.

https://www.etnews.com/20261111000306.p1: 강남언니 운영사 힐링페이퍼가 외국인 의료관광객을 겨냥한 오프라인 거점을 확대한다. 미국 시장 진출을 위한 신사업 발굴도 추진하며 글로벌 성장 동력 확보에 속도를 낸다. 11일 업계에 따르면 힐링페이퍼는 오는 12월 서울 명동에 '언니가이드센터' 2호점을 오픈할 예정이다. 언니가이드센터는 한국을 방문한 외국인 관광객에게 병·의원 예약과 현장 통역 등 의료관광 서비스를 지원하는 오프라인 공간이다. 지난 3월 신논현점을 오픈하며 기존 플랫폼 사업에서 오프라인으로 사업을 확장했다. 병원을 탐색하고 예약하는 데 그치지 않고 실제 의료기관 방문과 시술 과정까지 지원해 외국인 고객의 이용 편의성을 높이는 것이 목적이다. 이번 명동점 개점은 외국인 관광객이 밀집한 지역으로 오프라인 고객 접점을 확대한다는 점에서 의미가 있다. 힐링페이퍼 관계자는 “앞서 문을 연 신논현점에서 방한 외국인 수요가 빠르게 성장하는 것을 확인한 후 명동점에 2호점 오픈을 준비하고 있다”고 설명했다. 실제 신논현점은 오픈 5개월 만에 외국인 환자 유치 1600건을 돌파하며 방문 고객이 꾸준히 늘고 있다. 현장 통역 등 방문 전후 서비스를 강화하며 맞춤형 서비스로 입소문을 타고있다. 해외 시장 확장도 본격화하고 있다. 힐링페이퍼는 최근 미국 시장 진출을 위한 신사업 조직을 꾸리고 관련 인력 채용에 나섰다. 국내에서 운영 중인 외국인 관광객 대상 병원 매칭 서비스를 미국 시장에 적용하는 방안과 현지 수요에 맞춘 새로운 사업 모델을 발굴하는 것이다. 기존에는 해외 소비자를 한국 병원으로 연결하는 인바운드 사업이 중심이었다면 앞으로는 미국 현지 소비자와 의료기관을 연결하는 도메스틱 사업으로 영역을 넓히는 것을 검토 중이다. 기존 플랫폼 사업에 한정하지 않고 현지 클리닉 설립·운영 등 새로운 사업 가능성도 검토하고 있다. 한국행 의료관광객 유치 경험을 바탕으로 미국 현지 미용의료 시장에서 새로운 사업 기회를 찾으려는 움직임이다. 힐링페이퍼는 글로벌 미용 의료 시장에서 사업 영역을 다변화하며 외연 확장에 주력한다. 온라인 플랫폼과 오프라인 의료관광 지원 서비스를 결합해 인바운드·아웃바운드 고객을 공략하고, 해외 현지 시장으로 사업 무대를 넓힌다. 한국 병원과 해외 고객을 연결하는 기존 사업에서 나아가 현지 고객과 의료기관을 직접 연결하는 모델까지 모색하면서 글로벌 미용의료 시장에서 사업 영역을 다변화하려는 행보다. 글로벌 플랫폼 확장도 이어지고 있다. 미국·캐나다·호주 등 해외 고객이 한국 병원의 시술 정보를 검색하고 상담과 예약을 할 수 있도록 서비스를 제공하고 있다. 서비스 언어도 총 6개로 확대하며 해외 고객 유입 기반을 넓혔다. 힐링페이퍼 관계자는 “일본에서 플랫폼 사업이 성장하면서 확보한 고객과 병원 네트워크를 바탕으로 미용의료 산업 내 가시적인 성과가 나고 있는만큼, 다양한 글로벌 확장성을 검토하며 다양한 신사업을 구상하고 있다”고 말했다. 정다은 기자 dandan@etnews.com

http://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/27942.title: Nvidia probes CEO Jensen Huang over spy claims
http://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/27942.p1: SEOUL/SYDNEY: An internal investigation into whether a foreign intelligence effort targeted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has put his future at the AI chipmaker under scrutiny. Huang has been the most prolific salesman of the AI boom at the world's most valuable chipmaker. The probe, announced on November 8, followed a media report that Huang had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly passed information to Beijing. Huang told Nvidia's employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife, without disclosing details of the relationship. Nvidia said its board has confidence in Huang. Some analysts said the company has no natural successor in case he decides to step down. Analysts said a prolonged investigation or internal review could potentially delay Nvidia's investment decisions or product launches, with broader implications for the semiconductor industry. Ryu Young-ho, a senior analyst at NH Investment & Securities, said Nvidia's products would be difficult to replace, limiting the potential impact, although shipments to China could face further delays depending on how the situation develops. South Korea's deputy science minister said on November 9 that the government expected no disruptions to contracted deliveries of Nvidia graphics processing units despite issues currently facing the company. Nvidia shares tumbled around eight percent in early trading on November 9. "The market's probably telling you now this does no favors to the stock whatsoever in a time when there's a lot of conjecture as to the build-out of data centers," said Chris Weston, head of research at brokerage Pepperstone in Melbourne. But Weston said he did not think Huang, whom he described as the "godfather of AI", would be replaced. Huang is Nvidia's fifth-largest shareholder with a roughly 3.6 percent stake, according to LSEG data, and maintains tight control through an unusually flat structure in which dozens of executives report directly to him. But unlike Meta Platforms or SpaceX, Nvidia has no dual-class shares that would give its co-founder majority voting control. The New York Times reported last month that Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive of Singapore-based company Megaspeed, who U.S. authorities investigated and concluded was a Chinese intelligence asset. "The so-called Chinese spy narrative is purely a groundless accusation, slander, and a smear," Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters in Beijing. Billionaire investor Bill Ackman said on X the Nvidia CEO was an "incredible human", but if "indeed this is more than an affair, then it is obviously a real problem". U.S. President Donald Trump said he had not spoken to Huang about the allegations, but called him a fine person. Asked if he believed he should have acted on intelligence when he was briefed about it, Trump said: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honorable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it. You have to hear it." The New York Times reported that Trump was briefed on the intelligence findings about a year ago and chose not to act on the information. The fallout extended to South Korea, where Madison Huang, Huang's daughter and an Nvidia executive, canceled a planned visit to Seoul for an Nvidia conference, according to companies she had been scheduled to meet. South Korean AI startup Rebellions said it canceled events with her due to "unavoidable internal circumstances at Nvidia." Nvidia AI Day Seoul, a two-day event expected to draw about 2,000 participants, will proceed as planned, according to South Korean media.

Οι επαφές για την τριμερή συνάντηση Νωρίτερα, το Πεκίνο είχε επιβεβαιώσει ότι βρίσκεται ήδη σε επαφή με την Ουάσινγκτον και τη Μόσχα για την προετοιμασία της επικείμενης κορυφής, όπως είχε καταγραφεί στο προηγούμενο ρεπορτάζ του SBC . Ο σχεδιασμός εκείνος αφορούσε συνάντηση του Σι Τζινπίνγκ, του Ντόναλντ Τραμπ και του Βλαντιμίρ Πούτιν στο Σενζέν, όπου προβλέπεται να πραγματοποιηθεί η σύνοδος, ενώ τώρα η νοτιοκορεατική πλευρά τοποθετείται δημόσια για το περιεχόμενο που ενδέχεται να συζητηθεί. Η διαπραγμάτευση για τη μορφή και το περιεχόμενο Στην ίδια προπαρασκευαστική διαδικασία, η Κίνα επιδιώκει αυστηρά προετοιμασμένες δηλώσεις, με τη μορφή της συνόδου να αποτελεί ήδη αντικείμενο διαπραγμάτευσης μεταξύ των πλευρών, όπως είχε παρουσιάσει το SBC στο ρεπορτάζ για την προετοιμασία των συνομιλιών . Από την αμερικανική πλευρά, η Ουάσινγκτον επιδιώκει ουσιαστικό διάλογο για τον πυρηνικό έλεγχο, προσθέτοντας ένα συγκεκριμένο αντικείμενο στις επαφές που προηγούνται της ενδεχόμενης συνόδου των τριών ηγετών. https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p2: 이 대통령은 이날 오전 충남 아산 삼성전자 온양캠퍼스에서 열린 ‘충청권 메가프로젝트 착공식’에서 “현장의 기업인 여러분들이 갖고 계신 어려움을 저희가 적극적, 선제적으로 개선해 나가겠다”며 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 삼성전자가 온양캠퍼스에 짓는 6조원 규모의 고대역폭메모리(HBM) 첨단 패키징 공장 건설 현장 시삽 행사에도 참여했다. 이 대통령은 축사에서 “아산의 반도체 첨단 패키징 팹(공장)과 첨단 디스플레이 생산 라인, 세종의 인공지능 서버용 고성능 기판 제조시설 등 충청권 메가프로젝트 투자사업의 본격적인 착공을 온 국민과 함께 축하드린다”며 “과감한 투자를 결정하고 신속한 집행력을 보여주신 (삼성전자) 이재용 회장님을 비롯한 삼성그룹 임직원 여러분, 충청 시·도민 여러분께 깊이 감사드린다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “불과 4개월 만에 약속을 현실로 바꾸는 현장에 서 있다”면서 충남과 아산시 공무원을 향한 격려의 박수를 유도했다. 이날 착공식은 지난 7월 충청권 메가프로젝트 보고회 이후 약 4개월 만에 이뤄졌다. 이 대통령은 “충청남도와 아산시가 인허가 소요 기간을 평소 대비 3분의 1 수준으로 대폭 단축해 착공을 앞당길 수 있는 길을 열어주었다”며 “호남권과 영남권의 모든 투자계획도 차질 없이 추진될 수 있도록 중앙정부와 지방정부가 원팀이 돼 확실히 책임지겠다”고 약속했다.

https://aninews.in/news/business/indias-.p2: New Delhi [India], November 13 (ANI): India's exports to key Free Trade Agreement (FTA) partners registered strong growth during April-September FY27, with shipments to Singapore surging 103 per cent, Malaysia rising 83 per cent and ASEAN countries recording a 58 per cent increase, according to data presented by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on Friday. The data, presented during a press conference addressed by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal, highlighted India's expanding trade partnerships and recent developments in free trade agreements, including the implementation of the India-New Zealand FTA and progress under the India-European Free Trade Association (EFTA) agreement. According to the ministry, India's exports to Singapore more than doubled to USD 11.07 billion during April-September FY27 from USD 5.45 billion in the corresponding period last year. Exports to ASEAN countries increased to USD 28.06 billion from USD 17.75 billion, while shipments to Malaysia rose to USD 5.58 billion from USD 3.05 billion. Similarly, exports to Sri Lanka increased 73 per cent to USD 3.94 billion, while shipments to Oman rose 47 per cent to USD 3.29 billion. Exports to Japan increased 40 per cent to USD 4.10 billion, while shipments to South Korea grew 24 per cent to USD 3.91 billion.
